(Originally Amended) 25. A computer-readable medium, excluding signals or other transitory media, having stored thereon computer executable instructions that when executed by a processor of a computer performs steps comprising: utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information; providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server; receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information; establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications.

(Previously presented) 5. The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises an SMS message containing a URL link to a web page displaying a barcode.

(Previously presented) 6. The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a control SMS message instructing the mobile device to download at least one barcode image of at least one coupon associated with the certificate selection information.

(Previously presented) 12. The method of claim 1 wherein the mobile device comprises a first NFC-enabled device, and is configured to transfer the electronic value certificate to a second NFC-enabled mobile device.

(Originally Amended) 24. The system of claim 13 wherein the mobile device comprises a first NFC-enabled device, and is configured to transfer the electronic value certificate to a second NFC-enabled mobile device using near field communication (NFC) technology.
